claim_text: Seasonal-naive beats historical mean and last-value on one frozen 28-day development block
protocol: single chronological split; train up to 2026-11-05; validate 2026-11-06 to 2026-12-03
decision_bound: development evidence only, not a release claim
limitation: one block of one synthetic series; ignores promotions and trend

claim_text: SARIMA(1,1,1)(1,0,1,7) and additive ETS beat seasonal-naive on mean MAE over three identical rolling origins; SARIMA selected, ETS fallback
protocol: expanding window; origins 1250,1310,1370; horizon 14; history strictly before origin
metric: MAE primary, sMAPE diagnostic (lower is better)
decision_bound: prefer SARIMA if mean MAE within 5% of best; frozen before TDo1
limitation: SARIMA vs ETS gap below fold spread; seasonal-naive best at origin 1370; no promotion features

claim_text: Regime-aware reorder heuristic (target 2 low / 4 high, order clip 0-2) beats the random policy on cost, fill rate and unmet demand on every one of the five shared public seeds
protocol: common episodes: both policies on public seeds 11,23,37,51,71; one 40-step episode per seed; random rng = default_rng(seed+900001)
metric: total cost (lower), course fill rate (higher), unmet demand, mean stock, mean order
estimate: mean cost 41.16 vs 88.20; fill rate 0.992 vs 0.818; unmet 1.0 vs 14.0; mean stock 1.29 vs 2.29
uncertainty_or_repetitions: 5 seeds; cost std 6.91 vs 23.70; reorder better on all 5
decision_bound: development evidence only; reorder heuristic is the comparator TD4 Q-learning must beat
safety_or_fallback_rule: reorder heuristic is the transparent fallback policy
limitation: 5 simulated episodes in one synthetic environment; heuristic not shown optimal; assumes the demand regime is observed correctly

claim_text: Frozen tabular Q-learning policy matches but does not beat the TD3 reorder heuristic on five separate development seeds; both clearly beat random
protocol: one Q-table trained on seed blocks 11,23,37,51,71 x 350 episodes (alpha 0.18, gamma 0.96, epsilon 0.85->0.05); evaluated with shared evaluate_policies on separate development seeds 100011,100023,100037,100051,100071
metric: episode cost (lower), course fill rate (higher), unmet demand, mean stock, mean order
estimate: mean cost 42.78 q_learning vs 42.48 reorder vs 87.75 random; fill rate 0.985 vs 0.988 vs 0.812; unmet 1.8 vs 1.4 vs 15.2
uncertainty_or_repetitions: 5 development seeds; one training run (not independent replicates); cost std 5.04 vs 4.59 vs 12.18
decision_bound: development evidence only; Q-table sha256 61cce1915bd5798f53c22529c9dbdca52b38c2c946a5b186e28e2d777f19738e frozen for TDo2
safety_or_fallback_rule: reorder heuristic remains the transparent fallback
limitation: single training run and 5 simulated episodes; learned policy is almost identical to the heuristic; valid only for this simulator and its costs
